purpose: Blinded screening of automatic TMCP admission after source-selection and routing fixes, using isolated task-specific workspaces.

policies.description: Force and inject a TMCP packet.
Inject only when the admission and packet-utility gates compose.

tasks.prompt: Design the agent workflow, define routing, audit safety boundaries, and verify receipts before promotion.
Research the supplied sources, write the domain artifact, review the draft, and verify all citations.
Diagnose the failing route-normalization regression, implement the narrow fix, protect it with regression coverage, and verify release behavior.

Plan a reusable skill that rotates a supplied PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees with a user-selected output path. Do not create or edit files; return only the clarified scope, reusable resources, initialization steps, and validation plan.

evidence_boundary: Screening pilot. Each row uses a fresh isolated runner and judge. Runner wall time is self-recorded; model token counts remain unavailable.
